reference_ui_observation.scope: A HubSpot portal picker, native signals only
reference_ui_observation.note: 48 native options = 46 documented + 2 observed in the picker (Key stakeholder identified, Painpoint). Portals can also show custom signals (portal-specific, not catalogued) and integration signals such as Job change by UserGems when installed. Some picker labels differ from documentation; see ui_label.

signals.meaning: Entry to or exit from configured visit criteria
signals.prerequisites: Configured visitor criteria; positive entry/activity direction; current company match. Contact engagement must be established separately.
signals.crm_reengagement: Check renewed offer relevance against a prior documented discussion; never attribute company visits to a person.
signals.availability: Documented; client account and enrollment surface unverified

signals.prerequisites: Research intent topics configured in the Play setup (separate from Bombora surge topics); meaningful positive research change; company fit and independent contact relevance.
signals.crm_reengagement: Compare topic and positive direction with an earlier need or objection; do not claim the contact is researching.
signals.availability: Documented; client account and enrollment surface unverified

signals.meaning: Budget or spending context captured in conversations
